gap.titleEm: You assess them once in a while.
lines: In between, you have no data.
You do not know whether they are recovering.
You do not know whether the load is too much.
You do not know whether they get injured tomorrow.

dfa.description: The only parameter that tells you in real time which metabolic zone your athlete is in. No lab test. No CPET. Just a chest strap and a phone.

zones.title: Pure aerobic zone
zones.body: Active recovery, long endurance, aerobic base building.

zones.title: Transition (above VT1)
zones.body: Aerobic threshold crossed. Sustainable moderate load.

zones.title: Anaerobic zone (above VT2)
zones.body: Anaerobic threshold crossed. Intense effort, limited duration.

zones.title: Maximal load
zones.body: Maximum intensity. Sustainable for a few minutes only.

dfa.note: Updated every 5 seconds. Computed in a dedicated processor. Lab-grade precision.

live.description: Start a sport session, connect the strap, and watch everything live:
items: DFA Alpha1 with the 4 color zones
Tags during the activity (sprint start, pace change, break, end of warm-up)
TRIMP computed automatically at the end of the session

post.description: At the end of every session, the app walks your athlete through a quick questionnaire:

dashboard.description: ln(RMSSD) trend with an individual baseline and normal band (Plews method). See at a glance whether your athlete is in shape, overtrained, or at risk.

bands.title: Above the band
bands.body: Recovered. Ready for a heavier load.

dashboard.chartNote: Normal band in teal. Green dots = recovery, red = caution.
